Class WebConsoleServer

java.lang.Object
io.sbk.webconsole.WebConsoleServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class WebConsoleServer extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Lightweight HTTP server that stores bounded SBK histories and serves the SBK Web Console.

  • Constructor Details

    • WebConsoleServer

      public WebConsoleServer(int port, int retention) throws IOException
      Creates a Web Console server bound to all IPv4 interfaces.
      Parameters:
      port - TCP port
      retention - maximum snapshots retained per run
      Throws:
      IOException - if the server cannot bind
      IllegalArgumentException - if retention is not positive

    • WebConsoleServer

      public WebConsoleServer(int port, int retention, Duration idleTimeout) throws IOException
      Creates a Local Web Console server with a configurable idle timeout.
      Parameters:
      port - TCP port
      retention - maximum snapshots retained per run
      idleTimeout - delay before an inactive web console without browsers stops
      Throws:
      IOException - if the server cannot bind
      IllegalArgumentException - if a size or duration is not positive
